_comment: A dedicated, always-shown view (not competing in the scored Top-3 risks) because ransomware is the board-level threat most executive audiences actually came to read about, and 'Defender XDR: 0%' buried in a category table doesn't answer 'are we exposed to ransomware specifically.' Each stage lists the MITRE techniques that represent it (all cross-referenced against mitre-mapping.json — no technique id appears here that isn't defined there, enforced by validate-data.js). The engine (report-engine.js#computeRansomwareExposure) checks which sources are tagged with each stage's techniques and are active vs. locked; nothing about the stage list or its ransomware framing is hardcoded into the renderer, so adding a 7th stage is a data edit, not a code change.

blurb.en: Phishing, valid-but-compromised credentials, or an exposed RDP/VPN endpoint.
blurb.fr: Hameçonnage, identifiants compromis mais valides, ou point de terminaison RDP/VPN exposé.

blurb.en: Pivoting host-to-host via RDP or replayed credentials to reach high-value systems.
blurb.fr: Pivotement d'un hôte à l'autre via RDP ou identifiants rejoués pour atteindre des systèmes de grande valeur.

blurb.en: Killing or tampering with EDR/antivirus immediately before deploying the encryptor.
blurb.fr: Désactivation ou altération de l'EDR/antivirus juste avant le déploiement du chiffreur.

blurb.en: Stopping backup services and deleting shadow copies/backup catalogs before encrypting.
blurb.fr: Arrêt des services de sauvegarde et suppression des copies fantômes / catalogues de sauvegarde avant le chiffrement.

blurb.en: Staging and exfiltrating data before encryption, to extort with a leak threat regardless of backup state.
blurb.fr: Mise en scène et exfiltration des données avant le chiffrement, pour extorquer sous menace de divulgation, peu importe l'état des sauvegardes.

blurb.en: The final, most visible step — and the one that provides the least warning time of all six.
blurb.fr: L'étape finale, la plus visible — et celle qui laisse le moins de temps d'alerte des six.
